name: Stat row
purpose: Put the few measures that matter side by side.
description: Each measure carries its label, value, change, and the note that qualifies it.

guidance.summary: Puts the two to four measures a recurring view depends on side by side, each with its comparison.
useWhen: People return to a view to see how a few measures moved, and act when one changes.
A decision on the screen depends on a total or a rate, and that dependency is stated.

avoidWhen.text: The screen's job is to resolve pending work: show the items, not counts of them.
Attributes of one record are facts to read, not measures.
Measures that need a shared scale.
One measure that leads a report.

states.label: Default
states.description: A row of stat cards: label, value, change, and the note that explains it.

dos.title: Two to four measures
dos.description: More than four and none of them leads.

dos.title: A comparison on every value
dos.description: A figure means little without what it is measured against.

donts.title: KPIs on a task screen
donts.description: Counts of work compete with the work; nobody resolves a number.

donts.title: Repeating a table's totals
donts.description: The same figure twice makes people check which is right.

donts.title: A stat row inside a card
donts.description: Each stat already has its own surface.

content: Labels are short nouns; units sit with the value.
Notes say what the value is measured against: since last week, of 40.

notes: A group of stat cards; each reads label, value, change, and note in order.
The change carries its sign in text, not only a colour.

composition.defaultVisible: Every stat: label, value, change, and note.
composition.density: Stat cards wrap in balanced rows; in a dense screen prefer a metric strip or a metadata list.

redundantWith.reason: Two blocks of headline measures compete for the first look.

mistakes: Four KPI cards leading a screen whose job is to resolve work.
A second block of headline numbers.
composition.responsive: Two by two on a narrow screen; a lone last card spans the row.
